column1: # Pages deliberately not published, with the reason. audit.sh reports these as
# SKIPPED rather than MISSING, so a run's MISSING list only ever means "new work".
# Removing a line here does not publish the page — it just puts it back in the
# review queue for the next sync. Fix the cause in the dotfiles instead when you
# want a page online (rename the value, strip the name), then delete its line.

column2: real hostname (bbhost) plus the full 1499-package version inventory — fingerprints the machine
